_doc: Memes inside the blog posts, generated by scripts/memes.py through the meme-mcp server (Imgflip). Each one goes after the paragraph containing `after`. Templates: two text boxes only (the MCP takes text0 and text1). Text is sent in capitals, the classic meme look. Never reuse a template across posts.
